questions.q: What does Get-Help Get-ChildItem -Examples give you?
options: Real, runnable example usages straight from Microsoft's documentation, already on the machine
A list of every file in the current folder
A prompt to install a completely different cmdlet
Nothing — the -Examples switch does not exist
questions.explain: -Examples is often the fastest path to working syntax, faster than searching the web since it's already installed and version-matched.

questions.q: When should you reach for Get-Help <cmdlet> -Full instead of -Examples?
options: When you need every parameter, its type, and whether it's mandatory
When you want to delete the cmdlet from the system
When you want to skip reading any documentation at all
-Full and -Examples always return identical output
questions.explain: -Full gives the complete parameter documentation, beyond just example usages.

questions.q: What problem does Get-Command -Verb Get -Noun *Process* solve?
options: Finding the exact cmdlet name when you know what you want to do but not what it's called
Deleting all running processes on the machine
Installing the PowerShell ISE
Running Get-Help on every cmdlet at once
questions.explain: Get-Command searches installed cmdlets by verb and noun, surfacing Get-Process even if you couldn't have guessed the exact name.

questions.q: What does Update-Help do, and what does it require?
options: Downloads the full local help files; requires admin rights and internet access, run once per machine
Deletes all locally cached help files permanently
Only works inside the PowerShell ISE
Automatically rewrites your scripts to a newer syntax
questions.explain: On a fresh machine, PowerShell may prompt for Update-Help before full help content is available locally.

questions.q: What is the real DBA skill this lesson is teaching?
options: Finding the right cmdlet through discovery tools, not memorizing hundreds of cmdlet names
Memorizing every cmdlet in PowerShell by heart
Writing custom help documentation for every script
Avoiding the console and ISE entirely in favor of web searches
questions.explain: Get-Help and Get-Command mean a DBA can sit at an unfamiliar server and find the right command in under a minute, without the internet.
